result.instructions: Tools for Printify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which orders in my shop are still in production?"; "Show tracking numbers for shipped orders in my shop."; "Which products do I have in my shop, and which are not published yet?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Printify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run printify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run printify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run printify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. printify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: printify_create_order
tools.title: Preview or create an unsubmitted order
tools.description: WRITE: preview an order of existing enabled product variants in an API/custom-integration store. Set this exact store to Manual approval in Printify BEFORE confirmation, then pass manual_approval_confirmed:true, confirm:true and the approved preview_hash. The API cannot verify Manual approval; auto-approval can otherwise cause production/charges. Persistent operation_id prevents automatic duplicate creation. Does not submit production or send shipping notifications.

manual_approval_confirmed.description: Confirm that this exact API store was set to Manual order approval in Printify before creating the order. The public API cannot verify this setting.

tools.name: printify_send_to_production
tools.title: Preview or submit an order to production
tools.description: WRITE: separately preview and approve production of an existing order, including its destination and fulfillment costs. Can charge your linked Printify payment method. Requires production_charge_approved:true, confirm:true and preview_hash; use the same operation_id for retries. Uncertain submissions are never replayed.

tools.name: printify_create_webhook
tools.title: Preview or create a signed order webhook
tools.description: WRITE: preview an order/shipment topic and HTTPS receiver; confirm with preview_hash to register it. Uses the signing secret configured securely on the connection, never a tool argument or result. Shares event data with that receiver. Verify X-Pfy-Signature at your receiver; API acceptance is not proof of signature delivery. Duplicate/uncertain attempts are not blindly replayed.

tools.name: printify_delete_webhook
tools.title: Preview or delete a webhook
tools.description: WRITE: preview a shop's selected webhook, check expected_host against its destination, then confirm with preview_hash to delete only that webhook. Uses Printify's required host query safeguard and persistent operation deduplication.

tools.name: printify_update_product_prices
tools.title: Preview or update variant retail prices
tools.description: WRITE: preview integer-cent retail price changes on selected variants. Confirm with preview_hash to update Printify, preserving all other variants, flags, SKUs and defaults; verify readback. Does not publish to an external sales channel. Reuse operation_id rather than blindly repeating an uncertain update.

price.description: New retail price in cents, as an integer.

tools.name: printify_write_operation_status
tools.title: Check write operation
tools.description: Read the persistent state and known resource IDs for an operation on this connection in a shop authorized by the current token. Does not create, submit, update or delete anything. Reconcile an uncertain attempt before doing further writes or rotating the token; operation history is scoped to the original connection identity.

tools.name: printify_copy_products
tools.title: Copy products between shops
tools.description: Preview or copy selected products or a complete catalog between two Printify shops in the same account. Preserves title, description, blueprint/provider, variant IDs/prices/enabled flags, artwork IDs and print-area transforms. Preserves canvas side printing and image pattern rotation. This initial workflow does not copy tags, SKUs, channel IDs, publication state or generated mockups. Products with text/personalization layers are explicitly refused because their creation fields are read-only. Preview by default. confirm:true starts/resumes a durable bounded job; save job_id and keep calling with that job_id and confirm:true until complete. Duplicate prevention remembers copies made by this connector, including across restarts/jobs; pre-existing copies made elsewhere are not detected. An uncertain create is never automatically retried: inspect the target and use printify_resolve_copy. Do not change the source catalog during an all-products run. Requires shops.read/products.read/products.write. Confirmed copying requires the hosted connector's durable coordinator.

source_shop_id.description: Source shop ID; the token must have access to both shops in the same Printify account.

target_shop_id.description: Different target shop ID. New products stay as drafts and are not published.

product_ids.description: Selected source product IDs; mutually exclusive with all_products:true. Omit when resuming job_id.

all_products.description: Copy all source products with resumable pagination. Omit when resuming job_id.

job_id.description: A previously returned job_id to resume; supply the same source and target shops.

start_new_job.description: With confirm:true and a selection, restart enumeration after source-catalog changes; never combine with job_id. Permanent copied and uncertain mappings are retained.

batch_size.description: Maximum creates in this call (default 1). Calls are also bounded when skipping prior copies.

confirm.description: False/omitted previews only. True authorizes creation of new draft products.

tools.name: printify_copy_status
tools.title: Check product copy progress
tools.description: Read a durable product-copy job's progress, target mappings, failures and uncertain writes. Verifies that the current token can access both shops. Does not create or retry products.

source_shop_id.description: Source shop ID; the token must have access to both shops in the same Printify account.

target_shop_id.description: Different target shop ID. New products stay as drafts and are not published.

entry_cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous status page; lists all entries including older failures.

tools.name: printify_resolve_copy
tools.title: Resolve an uncertain product copy
tools.description: Resolve one failed or uncertain source product in a durable copy job. Provide an existing target_product_id to verify the exact supported fields against the checkpoint and record it as copied. Or set verified_not_created:true only after checking the target shop manually; this allows one future retry through printify_copy_products. Requires confirm:true, never creates/publishes/deletes anything itself. An ambiguous write must never be blindly retried.

source_shop_id.description: Source shop ID; the token must have access to both shops in the same Printify account.

target_shop_id.description: Different target shop ID. New products stay as drafts and are not published.

tools.name: printify_list_shops
tools.title: List shops
tools.description: List all shops connected to the Printify account. This is the entry point — each shop's `id` is required by the product, order and webhook tools. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops.json.

tools.name: printify_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in a shop (paginated). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products.json.

tools.name: printify_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get a single product's full details (variants, images, print areas, publish status). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products/{product_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders in a shop (paginated), optionally filtered by status or SKU. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders.json.

sku.description: Filter to orders containing this SKU.

tools.name: printify_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get a single order's full details, including `shipments` (carrier + tracking numbers). Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/{order_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_calculate_shipping
tools.title: Calculate shipping
tools.description: Get a shipping price quote for a set of line items to a destination address. Non-destructive — it only prices, it does NOT place an order. `line_items` is an array where each item is one of {product_id, variant_id, quantity}, {print_provider_id, blueprint_id, variant_id, quantity}, or {sku, quantity}. `address_to` is the destination (first_name, last_name, email, phone, country, region, address1, address2, city, zip, company). Printify REST: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/orders/shipping.json.

line_items.description: Array of line items to price (see description for accepted shapes).

tools.name: printify_list_catalog_blueprints
tools.title: List catalog blueprints
tools.description: List all blueprints (product types, e.g. 'Unisex T-Shirt') available in the Printify catalog. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints.json.

tools.name: printify_get_blueprint
tools.title: Get blueprint
tools.description: Get a single catalog blueprint's details. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}.json.

tools.name: printify_get_print_providers
tools.title: Get blueprint print providers
tools.description: List the print providers that can produce a given blueprint. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}/print_providers.json.

tools.name: printify_get_variants
tools.title: Get variants
tools.description: List the variants (sizes, colors) a print provider offers for a blueprint. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/blueprints/{blueprint_id}/print_providers/{print_provider_id}/variants.json.

tools.name: printify_list_print_providers
tools.title: List print providers
tools.description: List all print providers in the Printify catalog. Printify REST: GET /v1/catalog/print_providers.json.

tools.name: printify_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks configured for a shop. Printify REST: GET /v1/shops/{shop_id}/webhooks.json.

tools.name: printify_list_uploads
tools.title: List uploads
tools.description: List images uploaded to the account's media library (paginated). Printify REST: GET /v1/uploads.json.

tools.name: printify_publish_product
tools.title: Publish product
tools.description: Publish a product to the shop's connected sales channel (e.g. Shopify, Etsy). STATE-CHANGING: this locks the product and pushes the selected fields to the external store. The body is an object of booleans controlling which fields are published; all default to true. Printify REST: POST /v1/shops/{shop_id}/products/{product_id}/publish.json.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Printify
prompts.description: What you can do with Printify here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_order_status_and_tracking_numbers
prompts.title: Check order status and tracking numbers
prompts.description: The AI lists orders in a shop, filtered by status or SKU, and reads each order's shipments with carrier and tracking numbers. You see what is in production and what shipped.

prompts.name: review_your_products_and_their_publish_status
prompts.title: Review your products and their publish status
prompts.description: The AI lists products in a shop and reads one with its variants, images, print areas and publish status. You can find products that are not published yet.

prompts.name: compare_print_providers_and_options_for_a_product_type
prompts.title: Compare print providers and options for a product type
prompts.description: The AI lists catalog blueprints (such as a unisex t-shirt), the print providers that make a blueprint, and the sizes and colors each offers. It helps you choose a provider.

prompts.name: get_a_shipping_quote_for_items_to_an_address
prompts.title: Get a shipping quote for items to an address
prompts.description: The AI prices shipping for line items to a destination address. It only quotes the price and does not place an order.

prompts.name: publish_a_product_to_your_sales_channel
prompts.title: Publish a product to your sales channel
prompts.description: The AI publishes a product to the shop's connected sales channel, such as Shopify or Etsy. It locks the product and pushes the fields you choose to the store.
